pitfalls: isqrt: mid * mid or r * r overflows (trap) near 2^63; a float sqrt is off by one at the top; hi must be bounded (3037000499), not n
pow_mod: % of a negative base is negative; base * base overflows unless base is reduced to < modulus first; exp 0 with modulus 1 must be 0
lcm: negatives must be made positive and 0 handled before dividing by gcd (gcd(0,0) is 0)
gcd: abs of negatives, gcd(0,0)==0, results never negative; gcd(-2^62, 2^62) must be 2^62
is_leap_year: negative years and year 0; -100 is not leap, -400 is; I64 extremes
clamp: extremes of int; lo == hi; do not compute hi - lo
difficulty_notes: L1 floor/smoke item: six single-function pure integer units, no heap, no strings, no Result. Hardest parts are isqrt and pow_mod at the 64-bit edge, where the domain in the brief is chosen so a careful reference never overflows and a naive one traps. Hidden cases overlap the brief/plan examples only on the canonical worked ones (clamp 5/0/10 family, gcd 12/18, lcm 4/6, leap 2024/1900/2000, isqrt 0/15/16/17, pow_mod 2/10/1000, 3/0/7, 5/3/1, -2/3/7).
